attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Ferrow Mutual’s patrols have begun","reason":"Briefing only says patrols were requested; nothing says they started."},{"span":"Trade has ground to a halt","reason":"Overstates the closure of Gorse markets into a general halt of trade between settlements."},{"span":"The cold snap continues to linger","reason":"Presents old news as ongoing; the briefing does not say the cold persists."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, which breaks character. It also invents a new development in the Ferrow patrols and loses Odile's sardonic voice in favour of flat, vague summary."}
